newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: CMG sees further profit growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: CMG sees further profit growth in 1997.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch computer services firm CMG Plc said on Monday profit and turnover over the first four months of 1997 had comfortably outstripped those of the year ago-period, and added it expected further profitable growth in the rest of 1997.

"CMG's strong performance of 1996 has continued in the current year. Turnover and profit over the first four months of 1997, at fixed currency rates, have comfortably outstripped the results of last year," CMG chairman Cor Stutterheim said at the general shareholders meeting.
He said market circumstances in the Netherlands and Britiain remained good, adding the German activities had been reorganised and developed as planned.
Stutterheim said all sectors in which CMG was active experienced growth, adding only in a limited part of that growth was linked to the millennium and the introduction of the euro.
"We are full of confidence for the remainder of the year," Stutterheim said.
"We expect further good profitable growth for the group in 1997, in spite of 1996's strong rise in the British pound..," he said.
